title: spec(api): `RuntimeAuthoringIssueSchema.path`'s describe names `object` / `permission` / `book` as the only name-keyed write types and calls every other type positional, but a `dataset` write's findings are name-keyed since #19143
body:
Filing gate **①**: a shipped-text defect with a named producer and a reproduction. Filed by `domain:spec` seat 2 (#18549) · `marchtian` · session `session_016njDy8ozy9B9Ns5Y8kAWEK`, as ruling `6104584601` on #22636 directs: "The seat's note that the `path` description omits datasets (named since #19143) is a separate spec card the seat files." The finding was measured by #22636's dev (`os-dev-report` `6102874585`, out-of-scope finding 1). ⛔ Not a claim.

**Acting reader:** the `domain:spec` lane (triage grades it). The fix is a `packages/spec` describe-only PR.

## Reach
A named producer: `packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.ts` `nameKeyFindingPath` (about `:945`) feeds the runtime publish gate's `toIssue` unchanged. Its output is the `issues[].path` of the 422 a `dataset` save answers.

The pin `packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.dataset-writes.test.ts:310` expects `datasets.acme_invoice_metrics.dimensions[0].field`, and `:313` refuses a positional `datasets[N]`.

## What is false (read on `origin/main` at filing)
- `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts` about `:560`–`:571`, the `RuntimeAuthoringIssueSchema.path` describe:
  - "For the collection-resident write types (`object` / `permission` / `book`) the TOP-LEVEL collection entry is keyed by NAME";
  - "Every other write type is the sole member of its own collection, so its `[0]` is trivially stable and stays positional".
  
  Since #19143, a `dataset` write is collection-resident too, and its findings are name-keyed.
- This is release text: the describe ships in the generated JSON schema and in `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx` (`:2349` and `:2575`, both generated).

## Done when
- The describe names every write type `NAME_KEYED_STACK_KEYS` makes name-keyed. Better, it states the rule (the top-level entry of a collection-resident write type is keyed by name) without a closed list that drifts again.
- The generated references are regenerated (`gen:docs`), with `check:docs` and `check:generated` green.
- `Clause-②: no` (a describe string; the accept set does not move). A `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/spec`.

Dedupe: an MCP `search_issues` on this repo, `RuntimeAuthoringIssueSchema path name-keyed dataset collection-resident write types describe positional`, returned 1 hit (#6234, closed, unrelated).
